meta.frame: local metres east (x) / north (y) of meta.origin (Web-Mercator metres / k); z metres above meta.z_base = LiDAR ground under the item; lon/lat are the source's exact coordinates
rules: items only where a data record (OSM tag / licence-green city inventory) says so; nothing inferred
positions = exact source coordinates, never moved
heading_deg only from data (OSM direction / camera:direction, city facing field), else null; heading = compass direction the face points
kind_class control_point = OSM stop/give_way/traffic_signals/crossing node on the road way (the controlled point, not the pole), city signal records at the intersection
speed_limit_sign only from an actual sign record; OSM way maxspeed is never used
LiDAR poles = measured position, type unknown -> unknown_pole; a data item with a pole within 3.0 m is confirmed_by_lidar and takes the pole's measured height
public cameras only (government / traffic); OSM surveillance=outdoor|indoor excluded; no feeds
